units.source_text: 不大一会儿，名人到盥洗间去了，

en.t: Before long, the Master went to the washroom,

units.source_text: 然后来到隔壁的房间，同村松梢风他们说说笑笑，

en.t: then came into the room next door and chatted and laughed with Muramatsu Shofu and the others,

units.source_text: 他一离开棋盘，就格外精神。

en.t: as soon as he left the go board, he became especially lively.
